modern_workspace_increment.execution_preparation: Migration029 adds immutable typed presets and exact package/model/credential-version planning records, with project-composite foreign keys and one optional aggregate cap. Admin creates presets; existing scoped planning roles create preparations. Explicit output/time limits, sequential one-trial metadata; UI dollars convert exactly to integer micro-USD, with no money defaults. Readiness reads current metadata only and never decrypts keys or reads grading admission contents. All workspace dispatch/adapters remain unqualified; no launch endpoint, SDK/network action, job, approval, reservation or legacy key fallback. Existing Harbor agent-plan rejection of workspace profiles remains unchanged.
modern_workspace_increment.model_version_policy: Migration030 maps existing workspace connections to stable profiles without rewriting configuration/hashes. Current-base CAS creates immutable successor connections; provider changes require a new profile. Disable is irreversible here and blocks all versions for future planning. Superseded versions remain readable but cannot enter new preparations. Old frozen snapshots remain unchanged. Database triggers freeze workspace configurations while preserving legacy connection rules. Explicit credential-version selection prevents silent rotation; pricing/terms live under workspace-only metadata and never confer authority. Classic /providers listing excludes workspace rows without changing response shape.
modern_workspace_increment.credential_sdk_mock_contract: Internal Admin/project-scoped helper only, mandatory exact httpx.MockTransport and current frozen model/key binding. No HTTP route or default real transport. Native OpenAI/Claude/Gemini text SDK contracts use the exact resolved scoped key; no global key fallback, ledger write or availability promotion. Fixed host/path/POST/auth guards, one-request limit, sanitized transport errors and pre-SDK credential-echo suppression protect logs/results. Evidence is mock authentication/normalization only, never live, exact-model, Harbor-task or structured-output qualification. Live dispatch and shared spending admission remain unimplemented for workspace profiles.
